log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side
Light Screen ended on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Armor Tail blocks Prankster Tailwind/Trick Room and Basculegion Aqua Jet. Farigiraf sets TR safely behind Focus Sash. Kingambit threatens Whimsicott with 2× Iron Head and is very slow (63) under TR. Hatterene is backup TR setter with Magic Bounce; Gardevoir-Mega sweeps with Pixilate Hyper Voice. This mirrors the successful Game 1 TR core structure.
decisions.notebook:
Game 1: TR core Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Focus Sash) + Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate). Opponent's Politoed is Bold nature, Sitrus Berry consumed. Under TR, Farigiraf (72) always moves before Politoed (90–122), Gardevoir-Mega (138) moves after. Pixilate Hyper Voice is Fairy-type 108 BP STAB spread 0.75x; Psychic is stronger single-target. Focus Sash only activates from full HP — useless at 19%.

Game 2 plan: Armor Tail blocks Whimsicott's Prankster moves and all enemy priority. Kingambit Iron Head 2× into Whimsicott. Hatterene backup TR. Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice cleans.

decisions.rationale: Repeat the proven four, leading Whimsicott plus Metagross for screen/TR-control options and immediate pressure into the Psychic/Fairy core. Politoed enables rain while preserving Basculegion as the late-game cleaner. Metagross also discourages Hatterene and Mega Gardevoir.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 bring: Whimsicott, Metagross, Politoed, Basculegion. Opponent brought Farigiraf, Hatterene, Kingambit, Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Quiet; revealed Trick Room and Psychic. Hatterene: Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Quiet; revealed Protect and Psychic. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord; revealed Kowtow Cleave. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite; Trace copied Drizzle before Mega Evolution; revealed Protect after Mega Evolution and threatens Pixilate Hyper Voice. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability Wave Crash/Last Respects pressure when possible. Politoed supplies rain and Helping Hand. Metagross pressures the Psychic/Fairy core and benefits from rain reducing Fire damage. Whimsicott provides Light Screen and can reverse established Trick Room.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Kingambit)
decisions.rationale: Farigiraf sets Trick Room to enable our slow team; Armor Tail blocks Prankster and priority from both foes. Kingambit Iron Head into Whimsicott to break Focus Sash and threaten KO. If Whimsicott uses its own Trick Room to cancel, we at least get damage and keep Hatterene as backup TR setter; if it Tailwinds or attacks, TR goes up and we win the speed war.

Game 2: Armor Tail blocks Prankster and all enemy priority moves targeting our side. Whimsicott's Tailwind (ally-side) is not blocked. Farigiraf TR can be cancelled if Whimsicott uses Trick Room (-6 with Prankster) into our -7. Hatterene is backup TR setter. Kingambit Iron Head 2× into Whimsicott breaks sash. Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice cleans. Opponent has Politoed (Drizzle, Bold, Sitrus consumed in G1), Basculegion, Tsareena (Queenly Majesty), Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker).

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Metagross)
decisions.rationale: Trick Room counters Farigiraf’s likely setup: Whimsicott acts first, so Farigiraf’s subsequent Trick Room restores the normal field. Stomping Tantrum applies super-effective pressure to Kingambit and survives even a Black Glasses Kowtow Cleave from full.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 opponent brought Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf is Focus Sash Armor Tail with Trick Room/Psychic; Hatterene is Life Orb Magic Bounce with Trick Room/Protect/Psychic; Kingambit is Brave Black Glasses Supreme Overlord with Kowtow Cleave; Gardevoir is Modest Gardevoirite, traced Drizzle before Mega Evolution, and revealed Protect. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability Wave Crash/Last Respects pressure when practical. Politoed supplies rain and Helping Hand; rain also reduces Fire damage into Metagross. Whimsicott can use Trick Room to contest opposing setup. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

decisions.rationale: Under TR, Farigiraf (72) and Kingambit (63) both move before foes. Dazzling Gleam KOs the 1% Whimsicott and chips Metagross. Kowtow Cleave into Metagross is 71.7–121.9% with Black Glasses STAB, good OHKO odds. Whimsicott's Trick Room (priority -7) never resolves before Dazzling Gleam KOs it. Armor Tail blocks Bullet Punch.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Metagross)
decisions.rationale: Protect Metagross from Kingambit's guaranteed Kowtow Cleave OHKO while Whimsicott uses its last HP to establish Light Screen. This safely stalls a Trick Room turn, punishes attacks into Metagross, and provides lasting protection against Farigiraf and the opponent's other special attackers before Whimsicott is likely removed.

Farigiraf is Focus Sash Armor Tail with Trick Room/Psychic; Hatterene is Life Orb Magic Bounce with Trick Room/Protect/Psychic; Kingambit is Brave Black Glasses Supreme Overlord with Kowtow Cleave; Gardevoir is Modest Gardevoirite, traced Drizzle before Mega Evolution, and revealed Protect. Kingambit's Black Glasses Kowtow Cleave is a guaranteed OHKO on full-health Metagross, so do not expose Metagross to it under unfavorable Trick Room order.

decisions.rationale: Bring Politoed to preserve Basculegion for the late game. Politoed can support Metagross with Helping Hand, threaten Kingambit with rain-boosted Water damage, and establish rain for Basculegion later.

Armor Tail blocks priority moves aimed at the opposing side while Farigiraf remains active.

decisions.rationale: Under TR we move first. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave into Metagross has 71.7-121.9% to OHKO, bypassing Light Screen. Farigiraf Protect preserves Sash and Armor Tail—vital for TR+priority denial—while Kingambit likely falls to Politoed Weather Ball even if Metagross faints. Next turn Farigiraf + back Gardevoir‑Mega can attempt to clean under remaining TR.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Sash) set TR turn 1; Kingambit (Black Glasses, Brave) chunked turn 1. Whimsicott fainted turn 2. Opp back: Basculegion (Adamant, Adaptability, Mystic Water), Tsareena (Adamant, Queenly Majesty, Wide Lens), Ampharos-Mega (Modest, Mold Breaker). Light Screen til turn 6, Rain til turn 6, TR til turn 4 end. We have Gardevoir-Mega and Hatterene in back.

decisions.rationale: Hatterene at 44 Speed is the slowest mon under TR, moving first. Life Orb Dazzling Gleam pressures both foes with spread chip, and Magic Bounce deters status. Gardevoir-Mega's 120+ Speed moves last under TR, wasting its offensive potential. Double Fairy spread from Hatterene + Farigiraf threatens Politoed and any switch-in while TR remains.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Sash, Quiet) set TR turn 1; Kingambit fainted turn 3. Opp back: Basculegion (Adamant, Adaptability, Mystic Water), Tsareena (Adamant, Queenly Majesty, Wide Lens), Ampharos-Mega (Modest, Mold Breaker). Light Screen til turn 6, Rain til turn 6, TR til turn 4 end. We have Gardevoir-Mega (Modest, Pixilate) and Hatterene (Quiet, Life Orb, Magic Bounce) in back. Hatterene at 44 Speed is our slowest TR abuser.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Rain-boosted Weather Ball guarantees the Kingambit KO from its shown range. Kingambit may move first under Trick Room and can OHKO Metagross, while switching exposes Basculegion to Kowtow Cleave; the reduced-rate Protect is therefore the best available chance to preserve Metagross without sacrificing the knockout.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Hatterene Protects to survive Basculegion's incoming Last Respects/Wave Crash; Farigiraf Dazzling Gleams for spread chip through Light Screen. Farigiraf's Sash protects it from a single hit; if doubled it faints but Gardevoir-Mega enters safely. TR has 1 more turn after this.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Sash, Quiet) set TR turn 1; Kingambit fainted turn 3. Opp back: Basculegion (Adamant, Adaptability, Mystic Water), Tsareena (Adamant, Queenly Majesty, Wide Lens), Ampharos-Mega (Modest, Mold Breaker). Light Screen til turn 6, Rain til turn 6, TR til turn 5 end. Hatterene (Quiet, LO, Magic Bounce) is slowest TR sweeper. Basculegion's Last Respects is 150 BP (2 fainted allies) with Adaptability 2x STAB — OHKOs Hatterene and Gardevoir-Mega. Farigiraf immune to Ghost. Gardevoir-Mega (Modest, Pixilate) in back. Turn 4 play: Hatterene Protect, Farigiraf Dazzling Gleam. Next turn is last TR turn; plan to double-target Basculegion if possible.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Weather Ball chips Farigiraf while Basculegion removes Hatterene. With two allied faints, Last Respects is 150 BP; its super-effective Adaptability boost guarantees the KO even without Helping Hand. Light Screen keeps Basculegion safe from the available unboosted special attacks before it moves under Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four: Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Quiet, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Quiet, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord, Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO full Metagross. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite, Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Trace before Mega, then Pixilate. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical. Last Respects reaches 150 BP after two allied faints and is a guaranteed Hatterene KO. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at the opposing side while Farigiraf remains. Politoed supports with rain, Helping Hand, and Light Screen synergy; rain reduces Fire damage into Metagross. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

decisions.rationale: Protect Gardevoir to avoid a potential Last Respects OHKO, while Farigiraf chips Basculegion with Psychic. Trick Room and Light Screen expire after this turn; next turn Mega Gardevoir can outspeed and clean up with Hyper Voice.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Farigiraf (Sash unused, 54% HP) and Gardevoir (full, can Mega) vs Politoed + Basculegion. TR ends turn 5; Rain ends turn 6. Opp back: Tsareena (Queenly Majesty), Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker). Plan: Protect Gardevoir this turn, Farigiraf Psychic Basculegion. Next turn Mega Gardevoir Hyper Voice (Fairy via Pixilate) to sweep, Farigiraf supports.

decisions.rationale: Last Respects is 150 BP after two allied faints, Adaptability-boosted, and super effective into Gardevoir, making it the decisive KO attempt. Weather Ball pressures Farigiraf independently; if either foe Protects, the other is heavily punished, leaving a favorable 2v1.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four: Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Quiet, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Quiet, Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord, Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO full Metagross. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite, Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Adaptability before Mega, then Pixilate. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical. Last Respects reaches 150 BP after two allied faints and is decisive into Psychic targets. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at the opposing side while Farigiraf remains. Politoed supports with rain, Helping Hand, and Light Screen synergy; rain reduces Fire damage into Metagross. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

decisions.rationale: No Mega preserves Adaptability (2x STAB Psychic), giving 21.7–40.4% through Light Screen vs 34% Basculegion — best KO odds (~34% conditional on ~62% speed tie). If Basculegion falls, Politoed Weather Ball maxes 75.5%, so Gardevoir lives and Mega-sweeps next turn. Mega Psychic lacks Adaptability and KOs less often despite guaranteed first move; Protect is only 1/3 consecutive.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 down 1-0; Gardevoir is last mon standing with Mega available. Opposing bench: Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker, Thunder/Dragon Pulse/Focus Blast), Tsareena (Queenly Majesty, Power Whip/HJK/Triple Axel). If Gardevoir wins this 1v2, Mega Evolve immediately in game 3 lead to apply Pixilate Hyper Voice pressure. Opposing Whimsicott (Sash TW/LS) and Metagross (Expert Belt) are fast threats to respect; Basculegion's Last Respects scales with fainted allies and must be neutralized early.

decisions.rationale: Protect preserves Basculegion from a guaranteed Psychic KO while Politoed uses Icy Wind. If it connects, Gardevoir is slowed below Basculegion, enabling a decisive super-effective 150 BP Last Respects next turn. This is safer than attacking now into Gardevoir’s uncertain Speed range.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four: Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord; Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO full Metagross. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite; Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Adaptability before Mega and Pixilate after Mega. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical. After two allied faints, Last Respects is 150 BP and decisive into Psychic targets. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at the opposing side while Farigiraf remains. Politoed supports with rain, Helping Hand, and speed control. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

decisions.rationale: Mega Gardevoir Psychic into Basculegion is a guaranteed KO from 34%. Both foes outspeed me and Basculegion's Adaptability-boosted 150 BP Last Respects likely OHKOs, so Protect only delays the inevitable. The only winning path is if they misplay and don't use Last Respects—if they click Aqua Jet or Protect, I survive, KO Basculegion, and face Politoed 1v1 without rain. Mega Evolve now maximizes damage and bulk for the possible follow-up.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Gardevoir is last mon vs Basculegion+Politoed; Mega Evolve available. Opposing bench for game 3: Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker, Thunder/Dragon Pulse/Focus Blast), Tsareena (Queenly Majesty, Power Whip/HJK/Triple Axel). Basculegion's Last Respects scales with fainted allies and must be neutralized early in game 3. Whimsicott (Sash Tailwind/Light Screen) and Metagross (Expert Belt) are fast threats. If Gardevoir wins this 1v2, Mega Evolve immediately in game 3 lead for Pixilate Hyper Voice pressure.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand boosts the 150-BP Last Respects. Basculegion is guaranteed to move before the Speed-dropped Gardevoir, and the super-effective Adaptability-boosted hit maximizes the immediate KO chance; it also avoids the reduced consecutive Protect odds.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s established four: Farigiraf/Hatterene/Kingambit/Gardevoir. Farigiraf: Focus Sash, Armor Tail, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Hatterene: Life Orb, Magic Bounce, Quiet; Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Kingambit: Brave, Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord; Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Protect; Kowtow Cleave can OHKO full Metagross. Gardevoir: Modest, Gardevoirite; Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Adaptability before Mega and Pixilate after Mega. Preserve Basculegion for late-game Adaptability pressure when practical. After two allied faints, Last Respects reaches 150 BP and is decisive into Psychic targets. Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at foes while Farigiraf remains. Politoed supports with rain, Helping Hand, and speed control. Avoid consecutive Protect unless forced.

reflections.summary: Team selection left Ampharos-Mega on the bench despite facing a rain core. Hatterene was easily removed by a boosted Last Respects, and Kingambit fell to Weather Ball. Without an Electric answer, Gardevoir-Mega was overwhelmed by Helping Hand + Last Respects after Trick Room expired.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Ampharos-Mega instead of Hatterene. Lead Farigiraf + Ampharos-Mega: Armor Tail blocks Whimsicott's Prankster, Mega Evolve immediately, set Trick Room, and spam Thunder to eliminate Basculegion and Politoed before Last Respects scales.
reflections.notebook: Farigiraf's Armor Tail shuts down Whimsicott's Prankster Tailwind and Light Screen. Opponent preserves Basculegion for late-game with Protect and uses Helping Hand Politoed combos to secure KOs. Basculegion's Last Respects must be neutralized early. For Game 3, lead Farigiraf + Ampharos-Mega; Mega Evolve turn one for Mold Breaker Thunder in rain. Prioritize Basculegion; keep Gardevoir-Mega in back for cleaning Hyper Voice pressure. Opponent may bring Tsareena to threaten Kingambit with Fighting coverage, but Ampharos can handle it with Thunder.

reflections.summary: Won because Politoed removed Kingambit and Farigiraf while supporting a preserved Basculegion, whose boosted Last Respects swept Hatterene and Mega Gardevoir after two allied faints. The four and non-Mega configuration suited this Trick Room matchup.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and non-Mega plan, but avoid giving Metagross to Kowtow Cleave unnecessarily; preserve Basculegion for the endgame and eliminate Farigiraf before depending on priority.
reflections.notebook: Opponent uses Protect to manage Trick Room turns and may delay Gardevoir’s Mega Evolution until late. Preserve Basculegion for a Last Respects endgame, remove Farigiraf before using priority, and position Metagross away from Kingambit’s Kowtow Cleave.
